{{Quote|3V <nowiki>+</nowiki> Master <nowiki>=</nowiki> building strongest dark side army in the galaxy.|[[3V-1L]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:CoF" />}}
The '''Master's Top Secret Army''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] cult established by the incompetent and foolish [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark side adept]] [[Umbral]], self-styled as "the Master." The Master's Top Secret Army operated in complete secrecy, with little known about its activities, except that its members allegedly studied and served the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="TOR:CoF" />

During the [[Third Galactic War]] around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.3}}</ref> the [[Alliance Commander]] encountered [[3V-1L]], a zealous disciple, who was recruiting followers for the cult.<ref name="TOR:CoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Master's Top Secret Army appears as a reputation track to the Galactic Season 5 "Confidence in Power" in the [[September]] [[2023]] Game Update 7.3.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Confidence in Power">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230901-0|text=Galactic Season 5 "Confidence in Power"}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
